name: a call without a requestId is not deduplicated
a fresh call runs every admit and stores its final result
a replay with the same digest answers the stored result
a replay with other arguments is request-conflict
a call running within its lease answers request-running
a call running past its lease is taken over and resumes after its stored parts
a transient failure of admit 2 leaves the row running, so a retry within the lease is request-running
after a transient failure the lease lapses, and the call resumes after its stored part
a takeover whose first admit fails transiently leaves the lease as it was, so the next retry takes over at once
an admit that faults ends the call refused internal, stored as done, and a replay answers it
an empty requestId is invalid, and nothing is stored
a requestId holding U+0000 is invalid
a refused admit ends the call with that result
